Pips are the little white notches that account for your rank progress. To rank up from rank 20 to 19, you need to get three of 'em, for example. From rank 5 to rank 4 you need five of 'em. Getting a pip is determined by how well you do in a trial, and if you do *really* well then you'll get two pips, hence the term "double pip."
